messages:
maya: Hey team — PR 8560 is ready but blocked on architecture sign-off. The change adds a KV prefetch path for short sequences to reduce tail latency. I'm tagging this because shard safety and fallback routing are involved. Please advise if a lightweight RFC + 2-line arch note on the PR would unblock merge.

jamie: @maya can you paste the PR and a short summary of SLO impact? that'll help the archs triage quickly.

maya: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/8560 — TL;DR: <50ms median improvement on small prompts in perf tests, potential increased memory usage per shard (~40MB). Fallback currently falls back to non-prefetch path if KV misses.

sergio: quick question — does the prefetch change cross shard boundaries or is it per-shard-local?

maya: per-shard-local. We only prefetch within the serving shard; no cross-shard fetches.

sergio: OK that helps. still want an RFC pointer that covers correctness tests and kill-switch behavior. Please link RFC or add a small design paragraph in the PR describing: (1) why prefetch is safe per-shard, (2) how we detect/prevent memory blowups, (3) rollback plan.

nina: pinging @arch-team — this looks small but can affect tail latency SLO if misrouted. A short arch summary + perf numbers in the PR should be enough for a lightweight blessing.

maya: I can add a short section. Draft RFC is here (WIP): https://docs.internal.redwood/rfcs/0027-kv-prefetch. It currently has correctness tests and a mem-usage section. Do you want me to point to a specific section?

sergio: point to the "safety-and-rollout" heading and add the 40MB estimate inline. Also mention that the fallback is immediate (no queued inflight) so we won't double-request.

maya: done — PR updated with RFC link and 3-line arch note under "Design summary". Also added perf numbers and the kill-switch flag name: runtime.enable_kv_prefetch (defaults false).

infra-bot: Merge blocked: missing architecture blessing label.

sergio: I reviewed the PR diff quickly and left a couple of tiny comments. From an architecture perspective I'm OK to bless once CI passes and the design blurb is present (which it is). Adding :+1:.

nina: +1 from me after CI. please add a canary rollback plan in the rollout notes (e.g., 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m wait and metric checks).

maya: added rollout steps and canary metrics. Thanks all. Marking as ready for merge when CI and canary plan cleared. :thumbsup:
